```sql
SELECT SUM(r.points)
FROM main."drivers" d
JOIN main."results" r ON d."driverId" = r."driverId"
JOIN main."races" ra ON r."raceId" = ra."raceId"
WHERE LOWER(d."surname") = 'button'
  AND ra."year" = 2009
  AND r."points" IS NOT NULL;
```
